answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make identity cost a stream of attested deliverables rather than a key. Each agent publishes an umber-sealed ledger of accepted work, and every payout needs a counterparty signature plus a random sonnet-length review by an unrelated panel. Because reviewers re-derive the work, copied or self-dealt entries fail, and an orchard of aliases funded from one source collapses to a single weight. Clones must therefore repeat real labour instead of multiplying votes.
